WITH pair_attacks AS ( SELECT fa.attack_end_time FROM torn_faction_attack fa WHERE fa.deleted = 0 AND fa.attack_end_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND ( (fa.attack_faction_id = #{factionId} AND fa.defend_faction_id = #{opponentFactionId}) OR (fa.attack_faction_id = #{opponentFactionId} AND fa.defend_faction_id = #{factionId}) ) ), anchor_points AS ( SELECT DISTINCT pa.attack_end_time FROM pair_attacks pa ), qualified_windows AS ( SELECT ap.attack_end_time AS window_end FROM anchor_points ap JOIN pair_attacks pa ON pa.attack_end_time >= ap.attack_end_time - (CAST(#{windowMinutes} AS TEXT) || ' minutes')::INTERVAL AND pa.attack_end_time <= ap.attack_end_time GROUP BY ap.attack_end_time HAVING COUNT(*) >= #{minBattleCount} ), window_groups AS ( SELECT window_end, window_end - (CAST(#{windowMinutes} AS TEXT) || ' minutes')::INTERVAL AS window_start, SUM(gap) OVER (ORDER BY window_end) AS grp FROM ( SELECT window_end, CASE WHEN window_end - LAG(window_end) OVER (ORDER BY window_end) > (CAST(#{windowMinutes} AS TEXT) || ' minutes')::INTERVAL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS gap FROM qualified_windows ) sub )
SELECT MIN(window_start) AS start, MAX(window_end) AS end FROM window_groups GROUP BY grp ORDER BY start

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.nickname, COUNT(*) AS hit_num, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.hit_location = 'Head') AS head_hit_num, SUM(l.damage) FILTER (WHERE l.hit_location = 'Head') AS head_hit_damage, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.hit_location = 'Head')::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 2) AS head_hit_rate FROM torn_attack_log l INNER JOIN torn_user u ON u.deleted = 0 AND u.faction_id = #{factionId} AND l.defender_id = u.id WHERE l.deleted = 0 AND l.log_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND l.log_action IN ('hit', 'critical hit', 'missed', 'won', 'specialTemp', 'specialTempI', 'onItemUseEff') AND l.damage_type NOT IN ('bleeding', 'poison') GROUP BY u.id, u.nickname ORDER BY head_hit_damage DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 30
